46011-the-moving-picture-boys-and-the-fl.title: The Moving Picture Boys And The Flood
46011-the-moving-picture-boys-and-the-fl.creator: Unknown
46011-the-moving-picture-boys-and-the-fl.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "It sure is," and as Joe began to read, Blake looked over his shoulder, murmuring such expressions as: "Worst flood in years! Many houses swept away! Toll of lives will be heavy! Many deeds of heroism! Mississippi on great rampage!"

arxiv-1404-2622.title: Serre Intersection Multiplicity Conjecture and Hodge theory
arxiv-1404-2622.creator: Mohammad Reza Rahmati
arxiv-1404-2622.description: Abstract . We explain intersection multiplicity defined by J. P. Serre, in terms of the Poincare product in Hodge theory by a modification of the chern character map. We also discuss a formulation of the Euler characteristic via the action of correspondences on the Chow groups of projective varieties, assuming the Grothendieck Standard conjectures over ℚ l \mathbb{Q}_{l} .

arxiv-2009-03221.title: Analysis and Simulation of a Novel Run-and-Tumble Model with Autochemotaxis
arxiv-2009-03221.creator: Nicholas J. Russell, Louis F. Rossi
arxiv-2009-03221.description: Abstract We model, analyze, and simulate a novel run-and-tumble model with autochemotaxis, biologically inspired by the phytoplankton Heterosigma akashiwo . Developing a fundamental understanding of planktonic movements and interactions through phototaxis and chemotaxis is vital to comprehending why harmful algal blooms (HABs) start to form and how they can be prevented.

arxiv-2105-01976.title: GraphOpt : constrained-optimization-based parallelization of irregular graphs
arxiv-2105-01976.creator: Nimish Shah, Wannes Meert, and Marian Verhelst
arxiv-2105-01976.description: Abstract Sparse, irregular graphs show up in various applications like linear algebra, machine learning, engineering simulations, robotic control, etc. These graphs have a high degree of parallelism, but their execution on parallel threads of modern platforms remains challenging due to the irregular data dependencies.

arxiv-2201-00150.title: Cross-Domain Deep Code Search with Meta Learning Conference: 44th International Conference on Software Engineering; May 21–29, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA 44th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE ’22), May 21–29, 2022, Pittsburgh, PA, USA Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3510003.3510125 IS
arxiv-2201-00150.creator: Yitian Chai 1 , Hongyu Zhang 2 , Beijun Shen 1 , Xiaodong Gu 1
arxiv-2201-00150.description: Abstract . Recently, pre-trained programming language models such as CodeBERT have demonstrated substantial gains in code search. Despite showing great performance, they rely on the availability of large amounts of parallel data to fine-tune the semantic mappings between queries and code. This restricts their practicality in domain-specific languages that have relatively scarce and expensive data.

arxiv-2312-00227.creator: Aranya Lahiri, Claus Sorensen, Matthias Strauch
arxiv-2312-00227.description: Abstract . Let ( G , ω ) (G,\omega) be a p p -saturated group and K / ℚ p K/\mathbb{Q}_{p} a finite extension. In this paper we introduce the space of K K -valued overconvergent functions 𝒞 † ​ ( G , K ) \mathcal{C}^{\dagger}(G,K) .

arxiv-2404-05284.title: Tackling Challenges in 21cm Global Spectrum Experiment: the Impact of Ionosphere and Beam Distortion
arxiv-2404-05284.creator: Yue Wang, Xin Wang, Shijie Sun, Fengquan Wu, Shoudong Luo, Xuelei Chen
arxiv-2404-05284.description: Abstract The HI 21cm global signal from the Cosmic Dawn and the Epoch of Reionization (EoR) offers critical insights into the evolution of our Universe. Yet, its detection presents significant challenges due to its extremely low signal-to-contamination ratio and complex instrumental systematics. In this paper, we examine the effects of the ionosphere and antenna beam on data analysis.

arxiv-2406-04410.title: On Unitarity of Bespoke Amplitudes
arxiv-2406-04410.creator: Rishabh Bhardwaj, Marcus Spradlin, Anastasia Volovich, He-Chen Weng
arxiv-2406-04410.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rishabh Bhardwaj, Marcus Spradlin, Anastasia Volovich, He-Chen Weng. We use partial wave unitarity to constrain various bespoke four-point amplitudes. We start by constructing bespoke generalizations of the type I superstring amplitude, which we show satisfy dual resonance and have suitable high-energy limits. By analyzing the behavior of partial wave coefficients for highly massive states, we strictly rule out all bespoke amplitudes with asymptotically non-linear Regge trajectories and place constraints on the first few non-trivial parameters in asymptotically linear cases.

arxiv-2409-08523.title: Eir: Thai Medical Large Language Models
arxiv-2409-08523.creator: Yutthakorn Thiprak, Rungtam Ngodngamthaweesuk, Songtam Ngodngamtaweesuk, MD
arxiv-2409-08523.description: Abstract We present Eir-8B, a large language model with 8 billion parameters, specifically designed to enhance the accuracy of handling medical tasks in the Thai language. This model focuses on providing clear and easy-to-understand answers for both healthcare professionals and patients, thereby improving the efficiency of diagnosis and treatment processes.

arxiv-2601-10230.title: Volume penalization method for simulating flows around a rotating solid with multiple reference frame and sliding mesh Journal: Journal of Computational Physics
arxiv-2601-10230.creator: Ming Liu, Yosuke Hasegawa
arxiv-2601-10230.description: Abstract Despite the significant role of turbomachinery in fluid-based energy transfer, precise simulation of rotating solid objects with complex geometry is a challenging task. In the present study, the volume penalization method (VPM) is combined with multiple reference frame (MRF) and sliding mesh (SLM), respectively, so as to develop immersed-boundary approaches for simulating flows around a rotating solid.

arxiv-2602-10224.title: Internalizing Meta-Experience into Memory for Guided Reinforcement Learning in Large Language Models
arxiv-2602-10224.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite its efficacy, RLVR faces a meta-learning bottleneck: it lacks mechanisms for error attribution and experience internalization intrinsic to the human learning cycle beyond practice and verification, thereby limiting fine-grained credit assignment and reusable knowledge formation.

europmc-pmc4390258.creator: Combe CW, Fischer L, Rappsilber J.
europmc-pmc4390258.description: Unlabelled xiNET is a visualization tool for exploring cross-linking/mass spectrometry results. europmc-pmc5062097.creator: Seth AK, Friston KJ.
europmc-pmc5062097.description: We review a recent shift in conceptions of interoception and its relationship to hierarchical inference in the brain. The notion of interoceptive inference means that bodily states are regulated by autonomic reflexes that are enslaved by descending predictions from deep...

pmc-11405968.title: Bipolar Ablation From the Anterior Interventricular Vein to the Left Ventricle
pmc-11405968.creator: Joseph Adewumi, James Mann, Wendy S Tzou, Amneet Sandhu, Ryan G Aleong
pmc-11405968.description: Ventricular tachycardia from the left ventricular summit can be challenging for catheter ablation due to difficult accessibility and proximity to coronary arteries. This paper presents a case of premature ventricular contraction-induced ventricular tachycardia from the left ventricular summit that was ablated using bipolar radiofrequency ablation from the anterior interventricular vein and adjacent left ventricular endocardium.

pmc-11465777.title: Efficacy and safety of endoscopic subserosal dissection treatment for gastrointetinal submucosal tumors in the upper gastrointestinal tract
pmc-11465777.creator: Aili Wang, Qiong Niu, Yan Chen, Lijuan Liu, Xin Xiao, Chengxia Liu
pmc-11465777.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the safety and efficacy of endoscopic subserosal dissection for patients with submucosal tumors in the upper gastrointestinal tract.MethodsThis retrospective single-center study included 16 patients who underwent ESSD. All patients were enrolled from July 2018 to Dec 2021. Parameters such as demographics, size, resection margin, complications, pathological features, procedure time and follow-up were investigated and analyzed.

pmc-11582544.title: Screening for pulmonary hypertension in pregnant women with sickle cell disease in sub-Saharan Africa
pmc-11582544.creator: Alim Swarray-Deen, Misturah Y Adana, Micheal A Alao, Victoria AA Agyen-Frimpong, Adekunle Fakunle, Deda Ogum-Alangea, David N Adjei, Kwame Yeboah, Yemi Raheem Raji, Samuel A Oppong, James A Ogunmodede, Kolawole Wahab, Kola Okuyemi
pmc-11582544.description: BackgroundSickle cell disease (SCD) has evolved from a condition predominantly fatal in childhood to a chronic illness impacting many adults, including women of reproductive age. For females with SCD, pregnancy represents one of the greatest health threats, exacerbating existing health challenges and introducing new risks.

pmc-12358331.title: Positional and dimensional temporomandibular joint osseous changes in patients treated with the forsus fatigue resistant device: a non-randomized clinical trial
pmc-12358331.creator: Ramy Abdul-Rahman Ishaq, Maged S Alhammadi, Mona M Salah Fayed, Sherif A Elkordy, Najah Alhashimi, Abeer A Almashraqi
pmc-12358331.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess the osseous positional and dimensional changes in the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) of patients with skeletal Class II malocclusion treated with the Forsus Fatigue Resistant Device (FFRD).Materials and methodsThis non-randomized clinical trial included 40 female subjects, aged 11 to 15, with skeletal Class II malocclusion. Participants were divided into a treatment and a control group.

pmc-12540189.title: Effects of Maternal Peanut Intake and Breastfeeding Duration on Offspring DNA Methylation
pmc-12540189.creator: Jessica L. Garay, Margaret A. Voss, Stefanie R. Pilkay
pmc-12540189.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Emerging evidence suggests that maternal diet during pregnancy and breastfeeding may influence epigenetic modifications in offspring genes related to neurodevelopment and inflammation, although the specific mechanisms and long‐term implications of these effects are not well understood. This study evaluated the influence of maternal peanut intake during pregnancy and/or breastfeeding on the relationships between breastfeeding duration, household income, and child race with DNA methylation of genes associated with inflammation and neurodevelopment.

pmc-12569841.title: Tracking microplastic pathways: Real-time IoT monitoring for water quality and public health
pmc-12569841.creator: Priya Govindarajan, Veena Krishna Shahapuram, Prajanya ShivajiRao Ganesh, Vachana Manjunatha Basavalingappa, Keerthana Yenneholekoppal Balarama, Prakash Kumar Sarangi, Jun Young Cheong, Vinod Vellora Thekkae Padil
pmc-12569841.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Microplastics are a growing environmental threat due to their pervasive presence in aquatic ecosystems and their risks to both ecology and public health. Conventional monitoring methods, such as microscope-based analysis, are costly, labor-intensive, and impractical for large-scale deployment. To overcome these limitations, the study has proposed a cost-effective, IoT-enabled system for real-time detection and an algorithm to extract turbidity-based features for detection.The study introducess the Turbidity Enhanced Microplastic Tracker (TEMPT)—a cost-effective, IoT-enabled system for real-time detection.

pmc-12575817.title: Effects on nonverbal numerical acuity performance after a single-session transient random noise stimulation over the intraparietal sulcus or dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
pmc-12575817.creator: E Ó Dúinín, J K Steopan, K Kessler, F H Santos
pmc-12575817.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We investigated the effects of cognitive training with transcranial random noise stimulation (tRNS) applied to the intraparietal sulcus (IPS) or dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) on improving a multidirectional number line estimation task. We predicted that a single session of tRNS targeting IPS would enhance accuracy without affecting response speed, while a single session of tRNS targeting the DLPFC would improve response speed without influencing accuracy.

pmc-12614655.title: KRT23 promotes proliferation invasion and metastasis of gastric cancer through epithelial-mesenchymal transition mediated by the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway
pmc-12614655.creator: Yi Xie, Fanghui Zhou, Xuelian Li, Pailan Peng
pmc-12614655.description: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) is a highly prevalent and lethal malignancy worldwide. Notwithstanding advances in treatment, suboptimal patient outcomes highlight the urgent need for novel therapeutic targets to improve survival. This study aimed to explore the influence of keratin 23 (KRT23) on the proliferation, migration, and invasion of GC cells, as well as its underlying molecular mechanism.

pmc-13052319.title: Exploring small‐world brain connectivity in aging and its relationship with cognitive reserve
pmc-13052319.creator: Chiara Pappalettera, Selene Rossi, Anna Fabbrocino, Alessia Cacciotti, Lorenzo Nucci, Francesca Miraglia, Federico Frasca, Lavinia Valeriani, Petra Vukoja, Daniela Iacoviello, Paolo Maria Rossini, Guido Maria Giuffrè, Xu‐Yun Hua, Fabrizio Vecchio
pmc-13052319.description: INTRODUCTIONThe aging brain's vulnerability to decline emphasizes the importance of strategies preserving cognitive function and independence. As age‐related brain changes do not always match clinical symptoms, reserve, encompassing brain reserve (BR) and cognitive reserve (CR), has emerged as a key mechanism supporting resilience and mitigating cognitive decline during aging.

pmc-13173348.title: Under-reporting of carcinoma in situ in patients with high-grade papillary non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer
pmc-13173348.creator: Adam Cole, Daniel A. Shoskes, R. Jonathan Henderson
pmc-13173348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundConcomitant carcinoma in situ (CIS) with high-grade papillary urothelial carcinoma impacts patient risk stratification and treatment. However, on identification of a high-grade papillary lesion, pathologists may be disinclined to search for possible CIS.

pmc-13257897.title: Psychosocial care and experiences in young adults living with early‐onset type 2 diabetes: A narrative review
pmc-13257897.creator: Molly Caba, Márcia Carvalho, Angus Forbes, Rita Forde, Kirandip Gill, Mohsin Khalifa, Judith Parsons, Jane Speight, Paula M Trief, Michelle Hadjiconstantinou
pmc-13257897.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsTo review the literature on psychosocial care and experiences of young adults with early‐onset type 2 diabetes (EOT2D), to identify what is known, current gaps and to develop recommendations to help advance psychosocial care and support for the population.MethodsWe searched Medline (Ovid), Google Scholar and diabetes‐specific journals for English‐language articles focused on psychosocial aspects in young adults (aged 18–45 years) with EOT2D.

uslaw-usc-t17-s802.description: United States Code, Title 17 (Copyrights); Chapter 8 (Proceedings By Copyright Royalty Judges). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Qualifications of Copyright Royalty Judges.— (1) In general.— Each Copyright Royalty Judge shall be an attorney who has at least 7 years of legal experience.
